title: astracantha roseocalycina
intro: Astracantha roseocalycina, commonly known as the spiny Astragalus, is a type of perennial flowering plant in the legume family, Fabaceae. The spiny Astragalus has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of the spiny Astragalus include saponins, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which have been found to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
